response.explanation: At lines 12-21, src/presentation/server.ts imports eight concrete repository classes (ApiaryRepository, HiveRepository, HarvestRepository, InspectionRepository, ProductRepository, ScaleRepository, TreatmentRepository, WeightReadingRepository) straight from src/persistence/repositories.ts. At line 22 it also imports TextHiveClient from the persistence layer. The rest of the file works through the business layer: it imports HiveService, ReportService, ScaleService and TreatmentService (lines 2-5) and the business error types (lines 6-11), and createServer takes services as parameters (lines 56-60). The repositories are probably imported so the server module can build and wire the services, acting as a composition root, rather than for request handling. The visible excerpt stops at line 60, so this is not confirmed. Either way, FF-S03 forbids a layer from skipping the layer below it. Here presentation depends directly on persistence instead of going only through business, so the rule flags the edge server.ts:12 -> repositories.ts. The project supplied no docs, ADRs or comments that declare this wiring intentional or that allow presentation to see persistence.
